shared_elements: human or humanoid figures shown in profile/schematic form
repeated vertical stroke-like marks (crew strokes / feather and fringe hatching)
incised linear carving of figures on a flat stone surface
justification: Both surfaces carry carved figural imagery with repeated parallel strokes (crew marks in A, feather/fringe hatching in B), but A depicts multiple small schematic boats with stick-figure crews scattered over an open rock face, while B depicts a single large, near-naturalistic winged standing figure with elaborate robe, headdress and a stylised plant beside it. There is no shared motif, no comparable relationship between figures, and the conventions of depiction (matchstick silhouettes versus modelled, detailed relief) are entirely different.
